Coming to VR
About the Game

A forgotten village lies beneath dark floodwater

Scattered throughout its abandoned homes are writings left behind by those who came before you.

At first, the cursed priest only watches from a distance. But once you uncover the truth and begin destroying the objects connected to the ritual…

he starts hunting you.

01
Explore

Explore the flooded village

Move freely through flooded streets, abandoned houses, ruined paths, and eerie landmarks.

There is no fixed order. Explore wherever you want and uncover the story piece by piece.

02
The Mystery

Uncover the mystery

Find hidden notes scattered throughout the village. Each one reveals more about:

  • The flood
  • The missing villagers
  • The cursed priest
  • The ritual
  • The reason nobody can escape
03
The Curse

Break the curse

After uncovering the truth, four cursed objects must be found and destroyed.

Every object brings you closer to freedom. And makes the priest more dangerous.

04
The Hunt

Survive the hunt

The priest does not attack immediately. He watches. He waits. He disappears when approached.

But once the curse begins to break, he hunts you through the village.

Each chase becomes longer and more intense.

Features

What awaits you

01

Immersive VR Horror

Designed specifically for a tense first-person VR experience.

02

Open Exploration

Search the village in any order and discover the story naturally.

03

Dynamic Priest Encounters

Spot the priest praying, wandering, watching, and disappearing throughout the environment.

04

Escalating Chases

Every cursed object triggers a more intense pursuit.

05

Environmental Storytelling

Discover what happened through notes, abandoned buildings, sound, and atmosphere.

06

No Combat

When the priest comes for you, your only option is to run.

The village is waiting.

The roads lead back. The water never leaves.

And the priest is always nearby.

Can you break the curse before the village claims you too?
